subject.title: Config: scaffold compaction loop guard settings

question: Should OpenClaw reserve `agents.defaults.compaction.guard` as a public config surface before the saturated-session runtime guard behavior lands?
rationale: The PR adds inert public config/default keys, while the canonical saturated-session guard issue is still open for policy, default, validator, and reset-recommendation decisions.

options.title: Confirm contract before merge
options.body: Approve the guard namespace/defaults/runtime timing, then require a current-main rebase and real config-load proof before merging.

options.title: Accept reserved no-op config
options.body: Merge the scaffold as an intentional inert public API and own the risk that users can configure keys before behavior exists.

options.title: Pause in favor of the issue
options.body: Keep or close this branch as parked work and continue the design in the canonical saturated-session guard issue.

recommendation.title: Confirm contract before merge
recommendation.body: Approve the guard namespace/defaults/runtime timing, then require a current-main rebase and real config-load proof before merging.

likelyOwner.reason: The canonical issue review already routes the broader compaction guard policy decision to steipete, and this PR is the config-surface slice of that same decision.
